title.narrative: Nigeria for Women Program Scale Up Project

description.narrative: NFWP-SU will facilitate improved livelihoods and access to financial and select public services for women through targeted assistance following key principles of inclusion, objective targeting, transparency, and accountability, enabling culture, and openness to learning. The project aims to reach beneficiaries with financial and livelihood enhancement services bundled with other vulnerability reduction services like food and nutrition security, RMNCH, and WASH. NFWP will support the enhancement of voice and participation in decision making at the household and community level, responding to the demands of the participating women. The project will focus on creating an enabling environment for women to overcome institutional failures (including market) and barriers to enhance productive livelihoods and socioeconomic advancement. To accomplish the PDO, the project will develop and strengthen new and existing WAGs and Federation with a strong livelihood focus to enhance household income.
To institutionalize Women Affinity Groups (WAGs) and other platforms for women's economic empowerment and enhance the economic opportunities of unbanked women.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.1 (a): The Recipient, through FMWA, shall reconstitute and thereafter maintain,throughout the implementation of the Project, the Federal Steering Committee, with functions, composition and resourcessatisfactory to the Association and as elaborated in the Project Implementation Manual (PIM), to provide strategic guidance on theProject and promote experience sharing.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.1 (b): The Recipient, through FMWA, shall establish and thereafter maintain,throughout the implementation of the Project, a Project technical committee at the federal level (“Federal Technical Committee”),with functions, composition and resources satisfactory to the Association and as elaborated in the PIM.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.1 (c)(i): The Recipient, through FMWA, shall reconstitute and thereafter maintain,throughout the implementation of the Project, the Federal Project Coordination Unit (“FPCU”) and reconfirm its roles andresponsibilities for the Project satisfactory to the Association, with staff in adequate numbers and with qualifications,experience and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association, as elaborated in the PIM.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.2 (a): The Recipient, through FMWA, shall cause each Participating State, toestablish, no later than six (6) months after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain, throughout the implementation of theProject in said state, a multisectoral coordination structure (“Multisectoral Coordination Structure”), with functions, compositionand resources satisfactory to the Association and as elaborated in the PIM.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.2 (b): The Recipient, through FMWA, shall cause each Participating State, toestablish, no later than six (6) months after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain, throughout the implementation of theProject in said state, a technical committee (“State Technical Committee”), with functions, composition and resources satisfactoryto the Association and as elaborated in the PIM.

Financing Agreement, Schedule 2, Section I.A.2 (c)(i): The Recipient, through FMWA, shall cause each Participating State, toestablish, no later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain, throughout the implementation of theProject in said state, a Project coordination unit (“State Project Coordination Unit” or “SPCU”), with functions and resourcessatisfactory to the Association, with staff in adequate numbers and with qualifications, experience and terms of referencesatisfactory to the Association, as elaborated in the PIM.

title.narrative: Women without a bank account or mobile wallet

comment.narrative: Counts the number of initially unbanked women who opened an account or mobile wallet as a result of joining a WAG. We estimate that approx. 3.1m women will open accounts as a result of joining a WAG. To arrive at the total number of unbanked women in Nigeria, the 2021 Global Findex indicator "Account, female (% age 15+)" is applied to the estimated 2021 population values from the WDI downloadd prior to the June 30, 2022 update. The Global Findex is released every three years, therefore updated results will only be available in 2025 and 2028.

Counts the average savings per WAG member.
Numerator: Total WAG savings Denominator: Total number of WAG members

title.narrative: Grievances registered and satisfactorily resolved or referred within specified time frames

comment.narrative: Measures the proportion of complaints received by the GRM that are registered and either satisfactorily resolved or referred (in the case of GBV complaints) within agreed time frames as stipulated in the GRM manual. Numerator: Number of satisfactorily resolved/referred grievances within specific timeframes Denominator: Total number of grievances registered

title.narrative: Savings mobilized by WAGs per year before share out

comment.narrative: Counts the total member savings mobilized by WAG members per year before their annual cycle share out. Intermediate indicators are yearly targets and not cumulative over time.

title.narrative: Village Organizations and Cluster-Level Federations in operation that have achieved good quality standards based on an agreed rating system

comment.narrative: Counts the number of Village Organizations and Cluster-level Federations achieving good quality grading based on regular meetings, partnerships created, services linked to WAGs, training facilitated and book-keeping, and graded B and above.

title.narrative: Increase in percentage of women with decision-making power over household expenditures

comment.narrative:
Measures the change in WAG members reporting increased decision-making power over household expenditures since joining a WAG.
Numerator: Number of WAG members reporting increased decision-making power over household expenditures since joining a WAG Denominator: Total number of WAG members

title.narrative: Livelihoods collectives formed that are functional at project closure

comment.narrative: Measures the percentage of LCs formed that are functional (e.g. active and providing input and marketing services to their members) at project closure. Numerator: Number of LCs formed that are functional at project closure Denominator: Total number of LCs formednder this project

title.narrative: WAGs that have prepared MIPs and received CIF (disaggregated by existing and new WAGs)

comment.narrative: Measures the percentage of WAGs that have prepared MIPs and received CIF. Numerator: Number of WAGs that have prepared their MIP and received their CIF Denominator: Total number of WAGs formed under this project

Measures the percentage of non-performing loans across WAGs using PMIS data. A non-performing loan is defined as one where the WAG member has not made any scheduled payments of principal or interest within the specified time. Numerator: Total number of non-performing loans from all WAGs Denominator: Total number of loans from all WAGs

title.narrative: Livelihoods collectives formed that have accessed grant support

comment.narrative: Measures the percentage of the livelihoods collectives that have received grant support from the project. Numerator: Number of LCs that have accessed grant support Denominator: Total number of LCs under this project

title.narrative: Livelihood collectives formed that receive demonstrations of climate-smart practices

comment.narrative: Measures the proportion of LCs that receive at least one demonstration of climate-smart practices. Numerator: Number of LCs that receive at least one demonstration Denominator: Total number of LCs formed under this project

title.narrative: MIPs financed from CIF that have undergone climate screening

comment.narrative: Measures the proportion of MIPs that have been funded by CIF that have undergone climate screening based on a screening tool provided by the project. Numerator: Number of MIPs funded by CIF that have undergone climate screening Denominator: Total number of MIPs funded by CIF

title.narrative: WAGs utilizing a digital application to record WAG transactions

comment.narrative:
Measures the proportion of WAGs that are recording their savings and loan activity digitally, using the project-provided application.
Numerator: Number of WAGs using digital saving app to record their savings and loans transactions Denominator: Total number of WAGs formed under NFWP-SU

title.narrative: WAGs trained on climate change and adaptation

comment.narrative: Measures the proportion of WAGs that have received climate change and adaptation measures training curriculum as part of their basic training package. Numerator: Number of WAGs trained on climate change and adaptation Denominator: Total number of WAGs
Measures the number of visits conducted by new NFWP States to resource states for learning about implementation of the WAG model.

title.narrative: Policies and programs at the state-level to support the functioning of WAGs and Federations

comment.narrative: Counts the number of policies and programs established at the State level that support the functioning of WAGs and Federations.

title.narrative: Project participants receiving training that express satisfaction with the training

comment.narrative: Proportion of WAG members that complete all modules of training and find these useful and satisfactory. Numerator: Number of WAG members that report satisfaction with the trainings Denominator: Total number of WAG members that have completed trainings

title.narrative: Annual consultations with CSOs for reporting of progress and receiving project feedback

comment.narrative: Measures the implementation of a consultation mechanism between the project and CSOs through annual meetings.

title.narrative: GBV service provider mapping and referral pathway completed for all NFWP States

comment.narrative: Measures whether a GBV service provider mapping and referral pathways have been completed for all States. It is expected that the GBV mapping will be completed within the first year of a State joining NFWP SU.

title.narrative: Functional WAGs supported (disaggregated by existing groups and new groups)

comment.narrative: Measures number of WAGs formed that meet the definition of Functional WAGs (defined as those with - (1) regular meetings; (2) regular savings; (3) at least 70% members attending all meetings). Disaggregated by groups that existed before becoming a WAG and new groups that formed as a WAG.

title.narrative: Increase in productive assets of WAG members

comment.narrative: Measures the percentage change in value of productive assets owned solely or jointly by WAGs members.

Measures the percentage of project supported Livelihood Collectives that have accessed bigger markets. Numerator: Number of LCs that have accessed bigger markets Denominator: Total number of LCs formed under this project

title.narrative: WAGs in operation that have achieved good quality standards based on an agreed rating system

comment.narrative: Counts the number of WAGs following the project good groups principles (group dynamics, financial capabilities and behavioral discipline), achieving good quality grading based on regular meetings, regular savings, internal lending, regular repayment and bookkeeping and graded B and above.

title.narrative: Lesson learning events at State and Federal Levels

comment.narrative: Counts the number of lesson learning events held by the project at State and Federal Levels where a report of project findings is presented to key stakeholders.
